column1: # Signature moves (Docs/PLAN.md *Skills that look like themselves*): one sentence per family per move,
# written from each family's design and kit and checked against the rules; key, seconds, sentence, role.

column3: Fighting stance, the right hand, holding a short sword, drawn back low at the waist with the point forward and the left hand raised open in guard, then a fast lunge on the right foot and a straight thrust forward into the target's chest, the arm fully extended and the body in one line behind it, then a sharp recovery back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand drawn back past the right hip, the body coiled low. Then one fast, complete 360-degree spin to the left on the spot, never pausing or reversing, the right arm straight out so the blade cuts a flat circle at chest height, ending facing forward with a stamp, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the right hand holding a double-headed axe, two fast blows: a step in with the left foot and a hard chop down from over the right shoulder across the target to the left hip, then the wrist turns and the other blade hacks straight back across the target in a flat backhand cut from left to right at waist height, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a curved sword in the right hand, the left hand up for balance. A quick step forward and only two cuts, facing the target throughout: a downward diagonal slash from upper right to lower left across the target, then the arm whips back in a flat backhand slash from left to right at chest height, then straight back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a curved sword in the right hand. He sinks into a low crouch facing the target, the sword drawn back past the right hip, the left hand reaching forward, coiled, then springs straight forward into a long lunge with one rising slash from lower right to upper left across the target's chest without spinning, holds the follow-through and returns to the fighting stance. In place.

Standing gracefully, the arms relaxed at the sides. The right hand lifts to touch the lips as the hips sway softly left, then with no pause a small step forward and the right arm sweeps out toward the target at chest height, the palm opening upward as if blowing a kiss, the head tilting to one side, then the arm lowers to the side. In place.

A graceful standing pose, both hands cupped together at the chest rise slowly to high overhead as the body lifts onto the toes and the head tips back, held for a moment, then the hands spring apart as if releasing a dove and both arms float down and outward in a wide, soft arc, the palms turning up and forward, showering the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing athlete's pose, a lyre in the right hand. The chest turns a little to the right as the right arm swings back at hip height, then turns back square to the target as the right arm slings forward flat at chest height in one sidearm throw, the arm stopping pointed at the target, and settles back to standing facing the target. In place.

A standing singer's pose, a lyre in the right hand at the side. The right arm rises in a wide arc to high overhead as the body lifts onto the toes, face turned up, then the heels drop and the arm sweeps forward and down, stopping at shoulder height, the palm open over the allies, held a beat, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand with an arrow already nocked. A quick step forward into a half crouch, turning side-on so the left arm points the bow straight at the target, the right hand draws the string to the cheek, a brief hold, then a sharp release, the right hand snapping back past the ear, and she rises back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow low in the left hand. Feet planted wide, she leans back, lifts the bow to aim up at the sky and draws the string to the cheek, holds a moment, then looses straight up, the right hand snapping back past the ear, the left arm sweeping down to point across the enemy line, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow low in the left hand, a quick step forward on the left foot into a hunter's half crouch as the left arm snaps the bow up level toward the target and the right hand draws the string back to the cheek in one fast pull, looses at once, the hand flicking back past the ear, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, a short spear gripped in both hands. A measured step forward on the left foot as both hands raise the spear before the face, point angled down, then drive it forward and down in one precise two-handed stab into the target's chest, and a controlled recovery back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short spear in the right hand. The right arm thrusts the spear straight up to the sky as the left arm points forward at the enemy in a rallying war cry, held a moment, then both hands take the spear down to waist height and drive it forward in a long lunging thrust straight at the target's chest, and back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing prince's pose, a spear in the right hand. He draws the spear back level at the shoulder, sighting along it at the target, then takes a short step forward on the left foot and thrusts it straight forward at chest height, the arm snapping fully out, as if loosing a ray of light from its point, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing prince's pose, a spear in the right hand. He lifts the spear straight overhead and the left palm open to the sky, rising onto the toes with the face turned up, held for a second, then both arms burst open and sweep down and out to shoulder height, palms forward and chest thrust out, as if pouring sunlight over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, low on bent knees with both hands raised like paws, then a quick step in and a rising claw rake of the right hand from low at the hip up across the target's chest and face, the left hand held back ready, and a light bounce back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, sinking into a deep crouch with the hips low and both hands raised like claws, rocking once like a cat about to spring, then an explosive spring forward, both hands raking down and apart from high overhead to beside the hips across the whole enemy line, landing low and light, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a coiled war whip in the right hand, the left fist low at the hip. The right arm swings back and out wide to the right, then cracks the whip flat across the front from right to left at the target's chest height in one sharp sidearm lash, the wrist snapping and the hips turning with it, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a coiled whip in the right hand. She throws both fists high overhead with the head flung back in a savage war cry, held a moment, then stamps forward and both fists crash down together onto the target's shoulders with the whole body's weight behind them, the knees bending deep, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched like a bear, an axe in each hand. He throws both arms wide and back with a roar, then lunges forward and swings both arms forward and inward at once like a bear's mauling swipe, the two axes biting into the target's chest from either side, the arms stopping a shoulder-width apart, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a stocky bandy-legged dancer with a tambourine in the right hand. A bouncy hop into one quick full turn on the spot to the right, the right arm swinging out wide so the tambourine slaps forward across the target at chest height as he comes back round to face it, then a bounce back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing skald's pose. The right arm swings out wide to the side at shoulder height like an orator addressing a hall, then sweeps round to the front and hurls the open hand at the target at chest height, the chest pushing out and the head jutting forward as if flinging a sharp verse, the left hand low at the side, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing skald's pose. The right hand lifts high overhead as if raising a drinking horn in a toast, the head tipping back as if singing to the rafters and the left hand low at the side, held for a second, then the right arm swings down and forward in a broad, proud toast over the allies, the chest lifting, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, a knotted stick in the right hand, the left hand on a sword hilt at the left hip. He cocks the stick back beside the right ear, then steps forward on the left foot and cracks it down in a short, hard stroke onto the target's shoulder, as if punishing a slack recruit, the left hand never leaving the hilt, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing lady's pose, a small round mirror in the right hand. A quick step forward on the left foot as the right arm swings the mirror up from beside the hip in one fast rising arc, stopping straight out at shoulder height with the mirror turned to the target, as if flashing moonlight into its eyes, holds a beat, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing lady's pose. She rises onto the right toes, the left leg lifting behind her, the right hand raising a small mirror high toward the moon and the left arm trailing low behind, floating a moment, then sets the foot down and sweeps the mirror down and forward in one wide arc over the allies, the left hand opening beside it, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing priestess's pose, a staff in the right hand. The upper body sways slowly back and the right arm draws the staff up beside the head like a cobra rearing, then the torso and arm dart forward together in one quick striking thrust of the staff toward the target at chest height, as if spitting venom, and sways back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, hulking and slow, the right hand, holding a heavy club, heaves it high over the right shoulder as the body rocks back onto the rear foot, then brings it crashing straight down onto the target's head with the whole body weight coming forward behind it, the left arm thrown back for balance, a lumbering pause, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, low and wiry, the left arm kept back at the side. He bows the head and holds the right hand out toward the target at waist height, palm up, as if offering a gift, then the hand darts up to the target's throat and rips outward across it in one short, vicious slash to the right, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing harvester's pose, bending forward at the hips, the right hand, holding a sickle, draws back low behind the right hip, then sweeps forward in a low, flat reaping arc at hip height that rises into a fling toward the target at chest height, as if casting a crescent of light, the left arm drawn back, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, serene pose, the knees bend as both palms lower in front of the hips, then the body rises slowly as the hands lift, palms turning up, to high overhead as if raising the harvest out of the earth, held a moment, then the hands part and sweep forward, down and outward in a wide sowing arc, scattering grain over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand. The right hand reaches back over the right shoulder as if taking an arrow from the quiver, then in one flowing motion the bow rises toward the target at chest height as the right hand draws the string to the cheek and looses at once, flicking back past the ear, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand. Feet planted wide, she draws the string to the cheek, aiming at the far right of the enemy line, and holds a moment, then turns the upper body from right to left across the whole line, loosing as she turns, the right hand flying back past the ear, fanning arrows along the line, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, loose-limbed pose, the body sways lazily to the left as if tipsy, then snaps upright as the right hand, holding a short wand, flicks forward from the hip with a twist of the wrist, releasing toward the target at chest height, while the left hand lifts a cup as in a toast, then settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, loose-limbed pose, both arms rise high overhead as the hips sway side to side in a wild dance and the head tips back laughing, then a stamp forward and both hands hurl forward together from overhead, as if flinging a wave of wine across the whole enemy line at chest height, the body leaning into it, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched and stiff like a risen corpse, a notched axe in the right hand. He lurches forward onto the left foot with dead weight, heaving the axe up behind the right shoulder and hacking it down onto the target in front in one heavy diagonal chop from upper right to lower left, the left arm hanging limp, then straightens stiffly back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, short and broad, a huge smithing hammer gripped in both hands. He heaves it straight up over the head, rising onto the toes, then brings it straight down in one short, compact blow onto the target in front as if striking an anvil, stopping at waist height with the knees bent and the back straight, then lifts back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, an axe in the right hand. The left hand joins the right on the haft as he swings the axe high over the head, then steps forward and chops it straight down onto the target in one heavy two-handed blow, as if splitting a log, the knees bending into it, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched and wolfish, the clawed hands low. He lunges forward off the back foot, the right claw raking down across the target's chest as the head drives in with a snapping bite at its throat, the left claw pulled back, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched and wolfish, the clawed hands low. He presses both fists together before the belly and strains outward as if chained, throwing the head back in a howl for a second, then the bond snaps and he lunges forward as both arms fly up and apart, the claws raking outward across the whole enemy line at chest height, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing, sly pose, the weight on one hip. The right hand rises before the face as if hiding a smile behind the sleeve, the head tilted, then the hips sway and the arm snaps straight forward at the target at chest height in one quick flick, as if tossing a wisp of blue fox-fire, the left hand still at the side, and she settles back to standing. In place.

A proud standing pose, the left arm kept still at the side. The right hand draws back beside the ear, then whips forward in a quick overhand cast toward the target at chest height, the hand snapping open as if hurling a spark of golden light, and settles back to standing. In place.

A proud standing pose, the left arm kept still at the side. The right hand rises to the cheek as if catching a golden tear, then lifts it slowly high to the sky as she rises onto the toes, held a moment, then sweeps outward and forward in one wide arc over the allies, the fingers flicking open as if scattering gold, and she settles back to standing. In place.

A standing queen's pose, a distaff held upright in the right hand, the left hand resting on the waist. She draws the right hand back beside the right shoulder, then flicks it sharply forward and down, the arm fully extended to point straight at the target at chest height, as if casting out a line of golden thread, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing queen's pose, a distaff upright in the right hand. She joins both hands before the chin and bows the head, still for a moment, then lifts the chin as both hands part and sweep quickly forward and outward low at hip height, palms down, never above the waist, as if spreading a cloak of protection over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched on heavy shoulders, a stone club hanging low in each hand. He swings the right club back behind the hip, then heaves it forward and up in one huge underhand uppercut that smashes up through the target's chest, the whole body heaving up behind it and the left arm swinging back, then settles heavily back into the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand. He spreads both arms wide to the crowd with the chest thrown out for a proud moment, then snaps into a quick step forward and a fast rising cut of the sword from low right up across the target's chest to high left, the left arm swinging back, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, tall and dignified, a broad curved sword in the right hand, the left hand at the belt. He draws the sword back past the right hip, then one heavy step forward on the left foot and a powerful flat cut from right to left across the target's chest in a crescent arc, the whole weight behind it, then a measured step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a broad curved sword in the right hand. He strokes his long beard once with the left hand, then with a thunderous battle cry raises the sword high overhead in both hands, chest thrown out, then a big stamping step forward and one colossal two-handed cleave down across the target from above the right shoulder to the left knee, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing king's pose, the right hand, holding a two-pronged spear, draws back to the right hip and holds it levelled at the target for a still moment of aim, then drives it straight forward at chest height in one short, hard thrust with a small step of the left foot, the left hand closing into a fist, then draws it back and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing king's pose, head bowed, the right hand slowly lifts a two-pronged spear upright to shoulder height, a grim pause, then drives it down to strike the ground beside the right foot with a heavy stamp, fist stopping at the hip, as the left arm sweeps forward and out, low and palm down, splitting the earth beneath the whole enemy line, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched forward with the elbows raised like half-folded wings, then a sudden lunge in and two fast downward rakes: the right hand, holding a dagger, rips straight down the target from high overhead, then the left hand's talons rake down right beside it, and a quick spring back into the hunched fighting stance. In place.

A graceful standing pose, a light sway of the hips to the left, then the right arm, holding a rattle, swings out from the right side and around to the front in a flowing flat arc at chest height, the wrist flicking toward the target at the end, and settles back to standing. In place.

A graceful standing pose, the right hand raises a rattle high overhead and shakes it as the hips sway side to side in a slow dance, the left arm curved low at the side, then a light step forward and both arms swing down and up and outward in a joyful toss, as if scattering petals over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword held low in the right hand. The right arm swings the sword back, up and over the head in one big circle like the arc of a rainbow, and with a firm step forward on the left foot brings it down onto the target in front at chest height, the left hand out for balance, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand. He cups the left hand to the mouth as if sounding a great horn and raises the sword high overhead, the head tipped back in one long call, held a moment, then lunges forward on the left foot and drives the sword straight into the target's chest in one powerful thrust, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A cold, still standing pose, the head tilted to one side. The right hand rises slowly in front to shoulder height with the fingers curled like claws, then shoots straight forward toward the target at chest height and seizes it as if gripping its heart with a cold touch, holds a moment, and sinks back to standing. In place.

A cold, still standing pose, both hands rise together in front of the chest with the backs touching, then slowly part and spread wide as if forcing open a great iron gate, the head tipping back, held a moment, then both arms thrust forward together with the palms open, pushing a cold wind across the whole enemy line, and she sinks back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, both hands gripping a big smith's hammer, they swing back low beside the right leg, then a heavy step forward and a rising two-handed uppercut swing up and forward into the target's chest, the hips driving through it and the body rising onto the front foot, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a roaring war cry as the right hand flings a big smith's hammer high overhead and whirls it once in a wide circle above the head, the chest thrust out, then the left hand joins it and a big step forward brings it crashing down onto the target with the whole body behind it, as if striking an anvil, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing queen's pose, the chin lifted, the right hand, holding a sceptre, rises to hold it upright in front of the face, then snaps it down and forward to point straight at the target at shoulder height in one sharp, imperious stroke, the left arm still at the side, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing queen's pose, the chin raised, both arms sweep slowly out to the sides and up into a wide fan above the shoulders like a peacock spreading its tail, the right hand holding a sceptre, held for a moment, then both arms sweep forward and outward, lowering to shoulder height with the palms down like a decree laid over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, broad and heavy, the right hand, holding a heavy club, swings back and up over the right shoulder, then a stomping step forward with the left foot and a crushing one-handed blow down and across onto the target's shoulder, the hips and torso turning hard behind it and the left arm swinging back, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, both hands grip a heavy club and raise it high overhead, the elbows and knees bent as if holding up the sky, straining for a moment, then a roaring heave and a colossal two-handed smash straight down onto the target, the hands stopping at knee height as the knees bend deep and the whole weight crashes behind it, then heaving back up to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing, light-footed pose on the balls of the feet, the right hand, holding a winged staff, cocks back beside the right shoulder, then a quick springy step onto the left foot, the right leg swinging up behind, as the right arm flicks forward like throwing a dart at the target at chest height, then the right foot comes back down and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, light-footed pose, the right hand, holding a winged staff, rises straight up to the sky as he turns once lightly on the spot like a rising whirlwind, the left arm out low, then he stops facing forward and a light step forward swings the staff arm down to point straight ahead over the allies, like a herald sending messengers off, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, the left fist raised in front of the left shoulder as if bearing a shield and the right hand, holding a short sword, cocked high beside the ear, then a firm, disciplined step forward and a short, hard overhand stab forward and down into the target's chest, then a measured step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the right hand holding a curved sword, a quick step in with the left foot and a forehand slash from high right down to low left across the target, then at once a rising backhand slash from low left back up to high right, the left arm back for balance, and a snap back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, rising onto the toes as the right hand, holding a curved sword, draws back high behind the head and the left arm points straight at the target for a moment, then a short hop forward and a chop straight down onto the target from overhead, landing with the knees bent deep, then rising back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing maiden's pose. The right hand reaches up high as if plucking an apple from a branch above, draws it back beside the ear, then lobs it forward toward the target at chest height in a light overhand arc, lifting onto the toes, the other hand still at the side, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing maiden's pose. Both arms rise slowly overhead and sway once to the left and back to the right like young branches in a spring breeze, the body lifting onto the toes, then both hands scoop down and toss forward and up, palms open, as if throwing blossom over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing priestess's pose, the right hand, holding a sceptre, lifts from the hip and traces a small, slow loop in the air in front of the chest, then thrusts straight forward toward the target with a small step of the right foot, the left hand opening low at the side, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing priestess's pose, both arms unfold slowly out to the sides and up into a high V like great wings opening, the chest rising for a moment, then both arms sweep forward and inward in one wide sheltering arc, stopping apart at chest height as if folding wings around the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, crouched low with the left fist raised as a guard, then a darting lunge on the right foot and a fast straight stab of the right hand, holding a curved dagger, forward into the target's chest, then a quick step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, stiff and upright like a risen corpse, both arms held straight out in front. Two rigid blows: a stiff hop in place with the feet together, landing as both arms swing up and chop straight down together onto the target's shoulders, then both hands jerk back to the chest and thrust straight forward at its throat, and he stiffens back into the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short mace in the right hand. He lowers his head like a butting ram and drives forward one heavy step off the back foot, ramming the target at chest height with the head and shoulders, both arms pulled back for power, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short mace in the right hand. He raises the mace high in front of him with a bellowing war cry, head thrown back, held a moment, then pivots hard on the left foot and brings the mace down and around in a great flat swing that crashes into the target at chest height from right to left, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A light, graceful standing pose, the left arm still at the side. The right fingertips rise to touch the breastbone as if drawing a spark of light out of the heart, then the arm unfolds toward the target and the wrist flicks forward at chest height, loosing it as a dart of starlight, the heels lifting as it goes, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, low and loose, a curved dagger held low in the right hand. The shoulders dip left in a quick feint, then he darts forward off the back foot and the right hand whips up in a short underhand stab into the target's chest, the left arm out for balance, and springs back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a curved dagger in the right hand. He dips into a low, mocking bow with the right arm swept out wide and back, holds it a beat, then springs upright and whips the right arm forward and across from right to left in one flat sidearm throw at chest height, as if fanning knives across the whole enemy line, and settles back into the fighting stance. In place.

A poised standing pose, then the right hand holding a small gold talisman sweeps up from beside the thigh in a light, rising underhand arc and flicks forward toward the target at chest height, as if releasing a feather onto the air, the left hand open at the side, and settles back to standing. In place.

A poised standing pose, both arms rise slowly forward and up into a wide V above the head, palms to the sky, the chest lifting as she comes up onto her toes for a moment, then both arms sweep outward and forward in two wide, gracious arcs of blessing over the allies, palms turning down, as she settles onto her heels and back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, the right hand holding a short sword drawn back beside the hip, point forward. A heavy, stamping step forward on the left foot and the sword punches straight into the target's belly, the whole body driving in behind it and the left arm sweeping back, the wrist giving the blade a vicious twist, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand. He raises the sword high overhead and flings the left arm wide, chest out and head back in a battle roar, held a moment, then lunges deep onto the left foot as the sword cleaves down from high right to low left in one huge arc through the whole enemy line, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand. A quick half-step forward into a low scout's crouch as the left arm snaps the bow up toward the target's chest and the right hand draws the string back to the cheek, then looses at once, the right hand flying back past the ear, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, coiled pose, the upper body rears back with a slow sway like a snake about to strike, the right hand raised beside the head with the fingers hooked like fangs, then the body and the right arm dart forward together in one fast strike toward the target at chest height, and recoils and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, bouncing lightly on the toes, a short winged wand in the right hand. He darts in with two lightning strikes: a sharp rap of the wand down onto the target's wrist, then at once a jab up under its chin, the left hand up and open and the feet never still, then a light skip back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short winged wand in the right hand. He bounces on the toes and dips low, coiled a moment, then pivots on the ball of the left foot and whips the right leg round and forward in a roundhouse kick, the shin and heel smashing into the target's ribs at chest height, arms flung wide, then sets the foot down light, back in the fighting stance. In place.

A composed standing pose, the left hand resting at the waist. The right forearm rises level before the right shoulder, the fist up as if an owl perched on it, then the arm pushes forward and a little up in one smooth falconer's toss toward the target at chest height, the hand opening as the bird is loosed, and settles back to standing. In place.

A composed standing pose, both hands meet before the chest, fingertips touching, then draw slowly apart and upward as if stretching a thread of light between them until the arms stand wide above the head, held a moment, then both arms sweep forward and down in one broad cast, palms up, as if throwing a woven net of light over the allies, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, hunched with the head lowered and the chin tucked, a heavy stamping step forward as the upper body drives low into the target, then heaves up and twists to the right in one violent upward toss of the head, as if hooking the target on the horns and flinging it over the right shoulder, the arms braced low, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, stiff and hunched with both arms half raised in front, then a slow lurching step forward on the right foot, both arms reaching straight out at chest height with the right hand leading, the hands clawing shut on the target and yanking it down hard toward the waist, then a stiff step back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing mourner's pose, the head bows and the right hand rises before the face in grief, then the head lifts sharply as the right arm flings forward and open toward the target at chest height, the fingers spread as if hurling a wail, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing mourner's pose, both arms sweep slowly up and out to the sides like a great bird opening its wings, the chest lifting and the head tipping back in a mourning cry for a moment, then both arms beat down and forward at once in one powerful wingbeat toward the enemy line, the body bowing into it, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, the right hand holding a short trident low beside the right knee, tines forward, the left arm out for balance. He sinks a little, then surges up and forward off the back foot, driving the trident up in one rising underhand thrust into the target's chest like a wave breaking against a rock, the body rising behind it, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short trident in the right hand. Rearing like a stallion, he lifts the right knee high and the trident high overhead with a roar, the left fist hauling back as if reining in horses, held a moment, then stamps the foot down and lunges, driving the trident straight forward into the target's chest in one long thrust, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, fierce and alert, a short baton in the right hand. A quick step in on the left foot and a whip-fast diagonal strike of the baton down across the target from above the right shoulder to the left hip, the left arm flung back for balance, then a light step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short baton in the right hand. He sinks low with both arms drawn back, gathering for a moment, then swings the right leg up and around in one huge roundhouse kick that sweeps across the whole enemy line at chest height, the arms flung wide for balance, without spinning round, and stamps the foot down back into the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, light on the toes, a quick step forward and two fast flat cuts of the right hand, holding a short sword, across the target's chest: a forehand from right to left, then at once a backhand from left to right, the left arm swept back like a wing for balance, and a light step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the chest lifts and both arms sweep back wide behind the body like opening wings, the right hand holding a short sword, rising onto the toes for a moment, then a short hop forward as the right arm whips over the top in a diving cut down onto the target's head, landing with the knees bent, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short knife in the right hand. He leans forward from the hips and jabs the knife straight into the target's chest at arm's length, the left hand braced on the front thigh, and draws back upright with the whole body as if pulling an oar, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short knife in the right hand. He rocks back onto the rear foot with the knife raised high overhead and bellows, like a wave drawing back from the shore, for a second, then surges forward onto the front foot and crashes the knife straight down onto the target's chest like a breaking wave, the body folding behind the blow, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing, majestic pose. Both hands swing a heavy lump of clay up and back over the head, then she steps forward on the left foot and hurls it straight at the target in one two-handed overhead throw, the body leaning into it and both arms following through toward the target at chest height, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing, majestic pose. Both palms up before the chest as if bearing a glowing stone, she bends the knees, then rises onto the toes and pushes both hands straight up overhead, pressing the stone into a tear in the sky, held a moment, then the hands part and both arms sweep outward and forward over the allies, palms open, and she settles back to standing. In place.

A light standing pose, the knees bending softly as the right hand dips low beside the right hip as if scooping water from a spring, then the arm sweeps up and forward in an underhand fling toward the target at chest height, the fingers flicking open to splash it and the body rising onto the toes, and settles back to standing. In place.

A stern, upright standing pose, feet planted, the right hand draws back beside the ear as the left arm points at the target, then the weight shifts forward as the right arm drives straight ahead in a flat javelin throw at the target at chest height, finishing with the right arm pointed at the target and the chest facing it, and settles back to standing. In place.

A stern, upright standing pose, both fists thrust up to the sky in a wide V as the head tips back in a long battle call and the chest swells, held for a moment, then a step forward as both arms swing down and forward to point ahead at shoulder height, the hands opening, driving the allies onward, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing king's pose, the right forearm, holding a crook, rises beside the shoulder and whips forward and down in a short, sharp lash toward the target, like cracking a whip, the weight shifting onto the front foot, then settles back to standing. In place.

A standing king's pose, the head and shoulders bow forward with the arms hanging loose, then the body slowly rises tall, the head upright and looking ahead, as both arms lift in front with the palms up to shoulder height and open wide to the sides, as if raising the allies back to life, held for a moment, then a slow settle back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, feet planted and the chest facing the target, two quick, equally hard cuts of the right hand holding a curved sickle-sword: first a rising cut from beside the right hip up through the target to high left, then at once an overhead chop straight down onto the target, and back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the knees bending and the body hunching, the right hand low at the right hip as if gripping something in a satchel, then he rises and flings the right arm up and forward in one wide arc to thrust it high toward the whole enemy line at arm's length, the face turned sharply away, held for a moment, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A grave, still standing pose, both hands gripping a long two-pronged staff held upright across the body. He leans slowly forward from the hips, tipping the pronged head out toward the target at chest height, then snatches it sharply back to the chest with both hands, as if hooking the soul out of it, the shoulders drawing back, and settles back to standing. In place.

A grave, still standing pose, both hands gripping a long two-pronged staff across the body. He bends the knees and bows the head low over the staff, gathering for a moment, then surges up tall onto the toes, thrusting the staff up and forward before the face as the chest swells, as if heaving the underworld up beneath the whole enemy line, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance facing the target, a short trident held level in both hands at the waist, points forward. A heavy stamp forward on the left foot and both hands drive the trident together straight ahead into the target's chest, arms fully extended, hips and chest square to the target the whole time, then a sharp pull straight back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short trident gripped in both hands. Both arms raise the trident high overhead as the head tips back in a roar, held a moment, then he hops a short step forward and drives the trident straight down through the target in front to knee height as if splitting the earth, landing in a wide low stance, and rises back into the fighting stance. In place.

A calm, upright standing pose facing the target. The right hand lifts to the lips as if whispering a word, then snaps straight out at the target's chest in one fast flick with a short step forward on the left foot, the fingers springing open at full reach. At once the arm drops and he settles back to standing. In place.

A calm, upright standing pose, the knees bend and both hands grip together low in front of the thighs as if taking hold of a heavy pillar, then in one powerful heave the legs straighten and both hands drive straight up overhead, raising it upright, then the hands come down forward and part toward the allies as it settles back to standing. In place.

A tall, proud standing pose, the right hand reaches straight up overhead as if seizing a ray of sunlight, then hurls it forward at the target in one fast overhand throw, stepping in with the left foot and the left arm pointing the way, and settles back to standing. In place.

A tall, proud standing pose, both arms draw back low beside the hips with the palms forward and the knees slightly bent, gathering for a moment, then a step forward and both arms drive straight out at chest height, the heels of the hands together and the fingers spread like rays, blasting across the whole enemy line, and settles back to standing. In place.

A jaunty standing pose, a quick skip from one foot to the other, then the body dips to the right and the right hand, holding a pan-flute, whips around from the hip in a flat sidearm flick toward the target's chest, as if tossing a pebble across water, the left arm flung up for balance, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, heavy and hunched with the shoulders rounded like a beetle's shell, then a stomping step forward that drives the right shoulder into the target as the right hand, holding a mace, clubs down onto it at head height in the same motion, then a heavy step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a dagger held point-down in each hand. The right arm circles back and up high above the right shoulder, the wrist curled like a scorpion's tail, then whips over the top and stabs down onto the target at chest height in one quick blow, the left hand held low and ready, and a snap back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a dagger held point-down in each hand. She rocks her weight onto the rear foot, spine arched like a scorpion's tail, both hands drawn back low beside the hips, coiled for a moment, then snaps forward into a deep lunge as both arms slash forward and outward in two broad arcs across the enemy line at chest height, and back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a quick feint dipping the head and shoulders to the left, then a step in and the right hand, holding a hooked sword, reaches forward at chest height and rips back to the right hip in a fast hooking, pulling slash, then a sly step back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the body leans back as the right hand, holding a hooked sword, circles slowly twice overhead like a gathering whirlwind, then the body whips forward and the extended right arm slashes flat and wide from far right across the front to the left at chest height, cutting the whole enemy line, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, stiff and upright like a statue come to life, a small hoe in the right hand. With rigid, jerky movements the right forearm lifts the hoe to shoulder height, then chops it straight down and forward onto the target at chest height like a labourer hoeing a field, the head and torso held stiff, then the arm jerks back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a straight sword in the right hand, the left fist held up in guard. A step in and two blows: a hard diagonal chop down from above the right shoulder onto the target, then at once a straight punch with the left fist into its chest, as if striking with a shield's boss, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short blade in the right hand, light on the feet. She steps in with two cuts: a low reaping forehand across the target's middle, right to left like a scythe in ripe grain, then at once a rising backhand up across its chest, left to right, the left arm out for balance, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short blade in the right hand. She draws the blade back beside the right hip, eyes fixed on the target, still for a second, then lunges in hard: the left hand shoots forward to seize the target's shoulder and pull it close as the right drives the blade forward and up under its ribs in one brutal stab, holds, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing singer's pose, leaning forward from the hips like a bird on a rock, the right hand beckons with the fingers curling back toward the shoulder and the head tilting to one side, then the right arm flicks straight out toward the target at chest height, the clawed fingers spreading as if casting a song, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand. She plants the feet wide and bends the knees into a skier's crouch, raising the bow level toward the target in front as the right hand draws the string back to the cheek, holds the aim a moment, then looses, the right hand springing back past the ear, and rises back to standing. In place.

A standing archer's pose, the bow in the left hand. She leans back and raises the bow high toward the sky in front, the right hand drawing the string to the cheek, the whole body straining tall for a moment, then looses high into the air so the shot rains down across the whole enemy line, the right hand flying back, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance with a short spear held low in both hands at the right hip, a heavy step forward and a powerful two-handed swing from right to left across the target at chest height, arms extended, like a crocodile's tail lashing, the hips turning into it, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, the head thrown back in a roaring war cry as both hands raise a short spear high overhead, then a heavy lunge forward driving it into the target's chest with both hands, the whole body crashing in behind it and the torso twisting hard to the left like a crocodile's roll, then heaving back up to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, crouched low like a monkey, knees bent and both hands raised before the chest. The right hand darts up behind the right ear as if plucking a hidden needle, then shoots forward in a long jab at the target's chest as the right foot steps in, the arm fully extended as if the needle has grown into a staff, then back to the crouched fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, crouched low. He rises on the left foot, the right knee lifted high and the right hand shading the eyes, peering at the enemy, poised a moment, then stamps down, swings both hands overhead and slams them down to knee height in one huge two-handed blow, as if a giant staff cracks the ground under the whole enemy line, then back to the crouched fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, heavy and broad, a short sword in the right hand. He dips the sword down beside the right knee, then stamps forward on the left foot and rips it upward in one heavy rising slash from low right to high left across the target's chest, the whole body uncoiling upward behind it like a leaping flame, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand. He lifts the sword straight up to the sky with a roar, stretching tall, for a second, then steps forward and brings it down in one colossal sweep from high right to low left across the whole enemy line, ending bent over the front knee as if setting the world alight, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a heavy staff gripped low in both hands. A heavy step forward with the belly thrust out, and both arms heave the staff up from low in a rising two-handed uppercut into the target's chest, the round body lifting behind the blow, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a heavy staff in both hands. A bellowing roar with the staff raised high overhead and the right knee lifted high like a sumo wrestler's stamp, held a moment, then the foot stamps down and she lurches forward, driving the staff held level in both hands into the target's chest like a battering ram, the whole body behind it, and back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, square and upright like a soldier on parade, a short bronze sword in the right hand. He snaps the sword up before the face in a crisp salute, then raises it overhead, steps forward on the left foot and chops it straight down onto the target in one hard, drilled stroke, the left fist at the hip, then steps back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short war hammer in the right hand. He draws the hammer back behind the right shoulder, then steps in on the left foot and swings it forward and around in one fast, flat hook that smashes into the target's chest, the hips and shoulders turning hard behind the blow and the left fist pulling back, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a short war hammer in the right hand. With the feet planted wide, the right arm swings the hammer round in two fast circles above the head, calling the storm, then he stamps forward on the left foot and smashes it overhand onto the ground in front, the knees bending deep and the hand stopping at knee height, and rises back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a hand axe in the right hand cocked back at the hip and the left fist up by the chin. A short step in on the left foot and the right fist drives straight forward into the target's chest like a piston, the shoulder and hips turning behind it, then snaps back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, a hand axe in the right hand. He throws both arms up high in a wide V and roars with the chest out for a moment, then tucks the right fist up by the chin, drops the right shoulder and lunges forward off the back foot, driving the shoulder into the target's chest in one crushing body blow, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A standing hunter's pose, the bow in the left hand. He stands tall and still, lifts the bow level at the target at chest height and slowly pulls the string to the cheek with the right hand, holding the aim for a breath, then looses, the right hand opening back past the jaw, and settles back to standing. In place.

A standing hunter's pose, the bow in the left hand. He sets the feet wide and leans back, lifting the bow high toward the sky as the right hand pulls the string to the cheek, holding the upward aim for a second, then looses high and forward so the arrows arc down on the whole enemy line, the right hand flying back, and settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, a short sword in the right hand. A quick step forward and two strikes: a hard, straight thrust into the target's chest, then the arm pulls back and cuts across in a flat slash from right to left through the target at chest height, the hips turning with it, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

A serene standing pose. The left hand lifts a small oil lamp to chest height in front of the body as the right hand cups gently around its flame, then the right hand draws back and pushes forward, palm open, toward the target at chest height, as if casting the ember at it, and both hands lower as she settles back to standing. In place.

Fighting stance, an axe held low in the right hand. He rocks his weight onto the left foot, draws the right knee up high, then drives the right boot straight forward into the target's chest in one heavy stamping kick, the arms held in close for balance, then back to the fighting stance. In place.

Fighting stance, an axe in the right hand. He raises the axe high beside the head in grim silence, the left shoulder turning toward the target and the knees sinking, coiled for a second, then explodes forward in one heavy barging step, slamming the left shoulder into the target's chest as the axe chops down beside it, his whole weight in the blow, then back to the fighting stance. In place.
